proxy-addr.exposure: unauthenticated-request: X-Forwarded-For affects req.ip, rate-limit keys and logging
proxy-addr.remediation: override to 2.0.8 (patched upstream release), plus proxy regression tests

better-auth.exposure: unauthenticated-request: OAuth callback / state / social login endpoints
better-auth.breakingRisk: low - minor release within v1; full auth E2E suite passed

next.exposure: unauthenticated-request: image optimization, routing, cache and server rendering
next.breakingRisk: low - same major; build, Playwright and route generation passed

prisma.exposure: build/CLI and generated client; not directly request-parsing
prisma.remediation: direct upgrade 7.9.1 -> 7.10.1; effect override 3.22.5 closes @prisma/config advisory
prisma.breakingRisk: low - same major; prisma validate/generate/migrate all passed

@prisma/config.exposure: build/CLI config loading; effect ReDoS needs attacker-controlled schema input
@prisma/config.remediation: effect override to 3.22.5 (patched in 3.x, no major jump)

effect.exposure: ReDoS in Schema.TemplateLiteral; not fed untrusted request bodies by Kairos
effect.breakingRisk: low - Prisma CLI verified; effect 4.x major override was rejected after typecheck failure

brace-expansion.exposure: glob expansion in tooling; untrusted input only if tool processes attacker-controlled patterns
brace-expansion.breakingRisk: low - patch releases within each major line

axios.exposure: outbound HTTP from provider SDKs (Razorpay, Firecrawl, Tavily, Mem0)
axios.remediation: transitive upgrade to 1.20.0 via direct SDK upgrades

fast-uri.exposure: URI parsing in ajv; can influence SSRF-sensitive URL handling

firecrawl.exposure: outbound provider SDK; axios/zod advisories fixed by direct upgrade

follow-redirects.exposure: outbound redirects in provider SDKs; credential stripping bypass

inngest.exposure: durable job SDK; nested zod 3.x advisory
inngest.remediation: direct upgrade 4.18.0 -> 4.26.2 plus zod override to 4.6.7
inngest.breakingRisk: medium - zod major override; job integration suite passed

mem0ai.exposure: memory provider SDK; cross-tenant key collision and nested zod 3.x
mem0ai.remediation: direct upgrade 3.1.5 -> 3.3.1 plus zod override to 4.6.7
mem0ai.breakingRisk: medium - zod major override; no live provider credential available

multer.exposure: unauthenticated-request: multipart uploads behind auth middleware
multer.breakingRisk: low - same major; upload HTTP tests passed

systeminformation.exposure: host metrics via OpenTelemetry/worker diagnostics; not request-driven

undici.exposure: outbound HTTP in AI SDKs and tooling; TLS/redirect/cache advisories

zod.exposure: request/schema validation; oversized constrained collections can exhaust memory
zod.remediation: direct upgrade to 4.6.7 plus override forcing nested 3.x copies to 4.6.7
zod.breakingRisk: medium - nested consumers previously used zod 3.x; typecheck/build/tests passed

@grpc/grpc-js.exposure: OpenTelemetry OTLP exporter; mTLS auth context issue in specific configurations

@modelcontextprotocol/sdk.exposure: CLI provider SDK used by shadcn generator, not a Kairos request path

js-yaml.exposure: config parsing in build tooling; config files are repository-controlled

shadcn.exposure: component generator CLI; not imported by the running app
shadcn.remediation: direct upgrade 4.16.2 -> 4.23.0; residual moderate advisories are transitive CLI-only

source-map-js.exposure: build-time source map consumption; build inputs are repository-controlled
